prompt: Rendered in the style of an oil painting, a sun-drenched beach volleyball court hosts a tense moment. On the left stands a woman in a neon pink bikini, her body coiled in anticipation. Beside her, a man in a blue cap wipes sweat from his brow with a white towel, his posture slumped in exhaustion. In the center, a yellow volleyball hangs suspended in mid-air, caught in the golden light. To the right of the ball, a player in black shorts leaps high, arm extended upward to strike. Behind the net, a referee in a striped shirt watches intently, hands clasped behind his back. Near the sideline, a tan cooler sits next to a pile of discarded water bottles. The woman in the neon pink bikini is looking at the airborne yellow volleyball. The player in black shorts is reaching for the yellow volleyball. There is no audience in the background.
